protocol.averaging: equal weight per user with at least one eligible label
protocol.ndcg: binary relevance; ideal DCG over min(K, eligible relevant channels)
protocol.queries: one per training-known user at validation start; no validation feature updates
protocol.relevance: distinct validation channels within training catalog; repeat viewing allowed
protocol.unknown_coverage: unknown_user_pairs and unknown_channel_pairs use all validation_user_channel_pairs as denominator and may overlap; user counts use validation_users
